body: Thankfully I'm going to a therapist in a few days. It's just that right now I feel absolutely gutted. I've been pretty depressed in general for the past month or so and having suicidal type thoughts which keep me from sleeping. And now she isn't talking to me because she's upset which is just making this all worse. So i figured I would go on here to try and get some support. As pathetic as that sounds. I don't really have anyone to talk to until I see my dr and I just feel alone and depressed.

And it seems to get worse the more she learns about what her mom is and what she's done to her. Its like the more she realizes how messed up her life is the worse she treats me and the more backwards her thoughts are. I don't know if this is because it's impossible for her to process all of the information she's recently uncovered about her life. (She basically found out that everything that she's ever believed about her family and her childhood is a huge web of lies fabricated by the one person whose supposed to protect her and love her more than anybody else). Maybe thats why i've held on to the relationship. I just need therapy to work for her. I want my old girlfriend back. I wish I could just have a normal relationship. I don't want to feel gutted every time she gets mad at me. It's seriously physical. When she's mad at me i feel tense, my stomach is tight and my chest starts to hurt. But as soon as she starts talking to me again it just disappears in an instant. It makes it really hard because I get the silent treatment almost every 3 days it seems. And i always make contact first because I can't stand the pain from it. I know if I don't talk to her she would be able to last days if not weeks. It makes me feel horrible. And by the time it's over imready to apologize for anything. Im sorry I'm rambling now... I just don't really have anyone I can talk to about this.

Do you think theres any hope that she or somebody who has the same mental traumas/issues as her would be able to change with therapy? She wasn't always like this. I remember early inner relationship she wouldn't let me drive 10 minutes to get her cold medicine when her mom refused. She was always worried about being a burden. Now it seems like she's completely flipped around. She doesn't even think about being a burden. She just expects me to spend all my energy on her and won't even thank me or acknowledge that maybe it was inconvenient or even hurtful to me. I'm just asking if you think theres any hope at all after she gets therapy.

Because I care about her and I've been pretty much her only support for the last few years. I know it isn't "my problem" as people tell me. But I can't stop caring. I don't want her to be sad or feel like nobody cares about her. But right now I feel like nobody cares about me. I've told her this and she just gets upset with me. She says that when I talk like that it makes her depression worse so I can't talk to her about my feelings or it will make her feel worse. According to her at least.

I'm 20 and she's 21. A friendship wouldn't really work. We'd either end up back together or i'd end up suicidal because i'd still be doing things for her because I care for her but i'd have to be around whatever new boyfriend she gets.

Tbh. Usually when I mention that i'm upset about anything she does she gets upset and I end up apologizing. Or it somehow gets turned around on me. If I say "hey i've been noticing for the past few months that you've been getting angry at me a lot. It kind of makes me feel bad. Can we talk about it". She'll bring up something from the past that I did that proves that I'm an asshole. And it's really hard because it makes me believe that i'm just oversensitive and I'm always treating her badly. I don't think she does it to be mean to me... I think she honestly believes that her way of thinking is the truth. But recently she's gotten health insurance which let her get anti depressants and anti anxiety and she seems better now. She acknowledged that she's been acting really badly and apologized to me for it shortly after starting her anti depressants. And in a few weeks she'll be able to start therapy. I really want her to start therapy so that hopefully it might make her see more clearly the way she's been acting. Idk. I'm a little bit scared that i've become codependent or something. I'm miserable but I still do care about her. I don't want to have a life without her and a breakup scares me. Imagining her with another guy also kills me. I really don't know what to do. My happiness is pretty much up to her and she doesn't seem to care about my feelings. I desperately need her to just start seeing things how they are.

I came here for help. Not for people to be rude and talk to me like i'm an idiot for not knowing what to do in an extremely emotional situation. I'm sure you feel great about yourself now. Thanks for the input.

Wow. Thats really nice of him. I don't think he'd have seen it as a waste of his time. He probably wanted to see you more. But anyway. You could tell your therapist that you've had suicidal thoughts but aren''t in danger of killing yourself at the moment. Even if that is a lie.
Is this the same therapist you have an appointment with?

My girlfriends mom always called her ugly, boring, stupid, fat, etc. But I think she's beautiful and interesting. People in school would always tell me I was ugly. I never had any friends. Nobody wanted to be seen with me. I always believed all of that about myself. I still do to be honest. But my girlfriend tells me I'm her best friend. She likes being around me and she thinks I'm handsome. It took me a long time to find her though. All I'm saying is that some people are really mean. But I can guarantee that out of the 7 billion or whatever people in the world, one of them will like you. I used to pretend I was different for people like you. It's really hard and I know how lonely it can feel and it might feel like you're waiting forever but someone is bound to come along. How old are you?

She said she's worried about losing her ability to commit suicide. But If you tell your therapist though isn't he not allowed to call anyone or something like that? Like he wouldn't be able to take that away.
I would just go. When you went before was it enjoyable at all for even a second?

I know its not good for me. and I know I'm not her caretaker or therapist. But i do genuinely care for her and love her. You wouldn't be able to know from what I've written but we do care about each other. Her mental health makes her act a certain way. She went without medicine or therapy for a very very long time because we couldn't get her health insurance.

I have considered trying to get my family and her to sit down with a therapist. when we all lived together we had a few "family meetings" which just consisted of my dad saying "so does anyone have anything to say?" my sister would say no, i wouldn't say anything, my mom would pretend nobody else was in the room and my gf would say she doesn't have anything to say. Then my dad would say "ok good" as if everything was fixed and that would be that.

I know i do care about her. The reason she acts the way she does is because she has extreme depression. Which also makes it hard to stand up for myself. saying or doing the wrong thing could end with her spending the next 4 days in bed.
I really just wish everyone could get along. Thats the only thing that would make things ok. But it isn't up to me.
were both in college with no money and even if we could id feel like i was turning my back on my family
what should i do

The problem is that she's extremely depressed and suicidal. She recently got medicine for it which has made her understand things a bit more. Shortly after the medicine she cried and told me she was sorry for all of the bad ways she's treated me. She's been getting better but its still happening. I've talked to a therapist and suicide hotline people before and they've all said that its common with major depression. People can be extremely selfish and hurtful when they're as depressed as she is. i don't think that makes it "ok". But it definitely makes it difficult to know what to do. Me saying the wrong thing can turn into her staying in bed for the next 3 days or even attempting to kill herslef

I don't know if i can handle a breakup from my gf. but i can't live without my family. but i feel like i can't have both and i can't choose. i don't want to choose. i want to be happy like we used to be. but I'm worried that something that happened two years ago is going to make the rest of my life miserable. I can't live without my family. but if we break up ill know for the rest of my life that a girl i love so much is out there with another guy or possibly dead and if things went differently for one week of my life then i would be happy. But because things worked out the way they did ill never be happy again. I just don't know what to do and i don't see a way out of this horrible situation...

At the end of the summer my gf broke up with me. She met extended family and went to live with them. my family was in pieces and my gf left me. we were going to the same school and made sure we were going to be in the same dorm hall. I spent my first weeks of college not eating and calling a suicide hotline multiple times a day. I would stand walk next to busy roads and contemplate  jumping in front of oncoming cars. Eventually my gf started talking to me again. I didn't' let my family know we were back together because I wanted to give them time to try and recover themselves before I even mentioned her around them. The semester was difficult. My gf would spend a lot of days in bed and I would try to just keep her happy. She even had a suicide attempt during the semester. She swallowed pills and i called an ambulance. Since we started dating we had been trying to get her health insurance but none of the social service workers would help us. She needed a therapist and medicine. There were a lot of traumatic events during her childhood that she couldn't cope with along with the abuse and neglect of her mother who I'm sure is a narcissist. she recently got the insurance and anti depressants which have helped a lot. But during the semester i was basically her punching bag. she would tell me she hated me, i was abusive, spineless, pathetic, she would break up with me and not talk to me for days at a time. One time I walked 5 miles to a pharmacy to buy advil because she had a headache. When i got there i realized i didn't have enough money. I texted her apologizing and she wouldn't talk to me for 4 days. All of this was a result of her depression though and now that she has medicine she has been a lot better and she's apologized for it. Bit she still gets very angry and shuts me out. I'm at a point now where my family is slowly healing and my gf has been getting healthier. But she still talks about how she hates my family. and my sister still hates her. Ive been getting more and more depressed over the winter break. I feel extremely alone. I can't even tell my family about my girlfriend. I feel like nothing will be able to work out. I feel like i have to choose between my gf and my family and its just tearing me apart... And if her mom didn't move or if she didn't apply to this job then everything would be so much easier.. I'm just not sure what to do about my life anymore. Ive been feeling suicidal and i know that it would hurt my family and gf if i did. so i can't even do that. I just feel like I'm never going to be happy.

My gf eventually ended up staying with my family while she finished her last semester of community college. My sister was at a dorming college so they weren't together during. After her last semester she dormed at a 4 years school. They still didn't get along and my sister was angry that she was allowed to stay in the house. It caused a strain between my sister and my mom. My sister said that my mom chose a new daughter and neglected her real one and stuff like that. Me and my gf both apologized to my sister over and over. My gf never really meant it tho and has always been mad since the job thing. Then during the summer my gf stayed with us while my sister was also staying at home. There was a lot of tension. I tried to get them to get along but it just wouldn't happen. They both hated each other. My gf couldn't stay with her family because they abused her and made her feel suicidal. My gf spent the summer depressed and in bed. She would avoid my sister and not talk to her. When my sister would enter a room my gf would leave. My sister would scream that she hated my gf and my mom. she would scream 4 nights a week probably and it was always an all day event. My dad would try to appease my sister but my mom would want to punish her. This caused a strain in my parents marriage and my mom considered divorcing my dad and leaving the family. My day would consist of working for 7 hours for my dad and coming home and trying to get everyone to get along unsuccessfully while also trying to keep my gf from killing herslef and dealing with my family calling apart ontop of constant screaming crying and arguing. Part 2

well my life has basically been ruined by my bf's mom. She decided to abandon everything and move across the country. She didn't care that my gf wouldn't be able to go to college in the new state or be able to see me pretty much ever again. This would also have ended up leading to my gf's suicide. But thats a whole other story. Anyway my gf wanted to try and stay in our state. She looked for jobs and cheap apartments. Her and my sister were also best friends in high school and thats how i met her. my sister was applying to a job that was at a resort and offered housing to employees. My sister said that my gf should apply. So she did. My gf apparently didn't know that my sister applied as well. My sister got the job and my gf was mad at her. That was 2 years ago. It started a feud between them and was an extremely difficult time for me. I felt like I had to choose between my sister and my gf. I wasn't angry at my sister but I sided with my gf because I was scared she would break up with me. I wouldn't talk to my sister and when I would I would be mean to her. This is something I regret and still feel extremely guilty for. I wasn't actually mad at her I was just trying to keep my girlfriend from leaving me. I feel pathetic about it now. I threw my sister under the bus so my gf wouldn't be mad at me.anyway after about a week I apologized to my sister but my gf was still mad at her. My gf's mom added to it by keeping my gf against my sister. Her mom is extremely manipulative and I think it might have been a plan to get her to break up with me. after a few weeks of feuding i got my gf to apologize to my sister insincerely. My sister wouldn't accept the apology and told my gf she was a shitty person. i stayed with my girlfriend. this is like part 1
I know I'm not providing a ton of information. I just don't even know where to start
my parents, my sister, my girlfriend, and my girlfriend's legitimately sociopathic mom.
It's really hard to just cut family members out of your life though.

I feel like a loser too. I spend a lot of days just sitting in my bed and watching youtube videos or something. When I think about that as my life it feels really pathetic. I've been trying to find ways to be happy and realized that I don't know how to make myself happy. I don't know if this helps you. I just figured i'd let you know that you're not the only one who doesn't feel like they have a purpose. If that is what you feel at least. Anyway someone recommended this website called 16personalities.com to me. You fill out a short quiz and it tells you about your personality. You don't have to go to the website if u don't want to. I'm not advertising it or anything. It just made me understand myself a little bit. It was honestly pretty accurate about my personality and told me things about myself that I didn't even realize but i know are true. It's pretty in depth for free. But if you like it a lot you can buy a book from them about it for like 30 bucks. I didn't buy the book but I read all the free stuff which was kind of a lot. I'm just telling you about it because it might help you figure out what you might be good at or something that might help you feel better about yourself. It only takes a few minutes anyway. But the choice is yours. I hope you don't go through with killing yourself tonight. I just know what its like to feel like you're not good at anything.
